name: PR Review with Jev Routing
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends tmux jq && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && sudo curl -fsSL -o /usr/local/bin/ttyd https://github.com/tsl0922/ttyd/releases/download/1.7.7/ttyd.$(uname -m) && sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/ttyd && npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code && echo  | base64 -d | sudo tee /usr/local/bin/pks-git-credential >/dev/null && sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/pks-git-credential && (sudo git config --system --unset-all credential.helper || true) && git config --global credential.helper /usr/local/bin/pks-git-credential
